source.profile: One BLOCK_RECORD with four insertion units, 12 generated preview bytes, one referencing model-space INSERT and an APPID/string XDATA pair. The typed readback confirms the BLOCK_RECORD BLKREFS target equals the emitted INSERT identity. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Add a focused mode that emits the rich BLOCK_RECORD from writeBlockRecords(), writes its referenced INSERT in the entity phase, and registers the required APPID. Retry the same codec and require byte-identical output plus fresh typed readback of preview bytes, units, XDATA and BLKREFS-to-INSERT identity closure.
